verdict.rationale: Bun's docs explicitly support npm-style `workspaces` for developing several packages in one monorepo, with `--filter` installs, shared version catalogs, and self-contained hoisting barriers. `bun publish` strips the `workspace:` protocol, which implies cross-linked local dependencies, and a community report says isolated installs make monorepos more reliable. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that a single root `bun.lock` covers all workspaces, direct documentation of how the `workspace:` protocol links local packages, and stronger hands-on corroboration of monorepo use.
